summary:
Architectural blueprint and implementation plan for PayGate Multi-Domain Restructuring.
Key highlights:
- Subdomain-aware multi-app routing for:
  • merchant.example.com (/signin, /payments, /plans, /settlements, /developers, /settings)
  • admin.example.com (/signin, /payments, /wallets, /review, /payouts, /device, /audit)
  • api.example.com (/v1/payments, /v1/sms/webhook, /v1/devices/heartbeat, API docs & live playground)
- Ambient Dev Domain Switcher bar simulating subdomains in single-origin environments while supporting native production Host headers.
- Total extraction of SMS Forwarder Simulator from Merchant app into Admin portal.
- Single Super Admin SMS Forwarder Device with IP whitelisting verification (CIDR/IP whitelist, connection handshake, auto-detected client IP) replacing multi-device fleet telemetry.
